description: This file contains implementation of the Monitor plugin for WPEFramework, including API methods, event handling, and registration of endpoints related to monitor functionalities.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Class implementing monitor functionalities including endpoints for restart limits, reset statistics, status retrieval, and events.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers API endpoints and properties for the monitor plugin.

methods.name: endpoint_restartlimits
methods.description: Sets new restart limits for a plugin based on provided parameters.

methods.name: endpoint_resetstats
methods.description: Resets statistics for a plugin and provides the current info.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a plugin or all plugins.

methods.name: event_action
methods.description: Signals an action taken by the monitor for a specific plugin.
